summary: Assess complaints, disclosures, mis-selling and agent conduct. Practise proportionate monitoring and remediation for financial services.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review financial conduct, handle customer-protection controls or supervise services delivered through branches, agents and digital channels.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with banking, digital financial services, compliance, customer complaints or financial supervision is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Digital monitoring and complaint analysis are taught at operational application level; the course does not involve building automated supervisory systems.
